UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Official DPSube user profile and aggregated solving performance statistics.

photoUrl.description: Profile picture URL or local asset path.

cubeType.description: Primary puzzle category for future multi-cube scalability.

bestSingleMs.description: Personal best single solve time in milliseconds, or null if none recorded.

bestSingleLevel.description: Performance level of personal best single solve, or null.

currentSingleLevel.description: Performance level of the most recent official single solve, or null.

bestAverageMs.description: Personal best Ao5 session mean in milliseconds, or null if none recorded.

bestAverageLevel.description: Performance level of personal best Ao5 session, or null.

currentAverageLevel.description: Performance level of the most recent official Ao5 session, or null.

totalSingleSolves.description: Total official single solves (single solves + 5 per completed Ao5 session).

updatedAt.description: Last profile or statistics update server timestamp.

SingleSolve.title: SingleSolve
SingleSolve.description: An official individual Rubik's Cube solve from Single Tracking or an Ao5 session.

id.description: Unique document ID for the solve.

source.description: Tracking method that produced this solve.

averageSessionId.description: Associated Ao5 session ID if source is AO5, otherwise null.

AverageSession.title: AverageSession
AverageSession.description: A completed official Average of 5 (Ao5) session containing 5 solves and their arithmetic mean.

id.description: Unique document ID for the Ao5 session.

solveIds.description: Ordered array of the 5 associated SingleSolve document IDs.

solveTimesMs.description: Ordered array of the 5 solving times in milliseconds.

averageMs.description: Arithmetic mean of the 5 solving times in milliseconds.

averageLevel.description: Calculated performance level L0-L9 for the session mean.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each user's official profile and aggregated solving statistics.

/users/{userId}/singleSolves/{solveId}.description: Stores every official individual solve (from Single Solving or Ao5 sessions).

/users/{userId}/averageSessions/{session.description: Stores every completed official Average of 5 (Ao5) session.
